overview_description.description:
Rigetti Computing is a full-stack quantum computing company. It designs and manufactures quantum-integrated circuits. It packages and deploys those chips in a low-temperature environment, and they build control systems to perform quantum logic operations on them.

The company develops software to integrate its systems directly into existing cloud infrastructure. It has also developed new algorithms for quantum computing, with a focus on near-term applications in computational chemistry and machine learning. Our product, Forest, is the world’s first full-stack programming and execution environment for quantum/classical computing.

product.name: Rigetti Quantum Cloud Services (QCS)
product.description: A cloud platform that provides API-based access to Rigetti quantum processors and integrates them with public, private, or hybrid classical computing environments.

product.name: Rigetti Quantum Computing Systems
product.description: Superconducting-qubit quantum computers that combine Rigetti QPUs, cryogenic systems, microwave control electronics, signal routing, and software for executing gate-based quantum programs.

product.name: Novera™ QPU
product.description: A commercially available, on-premises 9-qubit superconducting quantum processing unit for quantum hardware, software, algorithm, calibration, and error-correction research.

product.name: Rigetti Quil SDK
product.description: A set of open-source quantum programming and simulation tools for writing, compiling, simulating, and executing Quil programs on Rigetti quantum processors.

product.name: Novera™ QPU Partner Program
product.description: An ecosystem and integration program connecting Novera customers with providers of cryogenics, control systems, quantum software, integration services, and quantum error-correction solutions.
